notes: SPX beta stress prefers beta calibrated from a TOS Position Statement CSV. Uncalibrated tickers fall back to a 5-year monthly Schwab-price beta versus SPX.
Option stress uses constant-IV Sticky-Strike theoretical repricing. Schwab also evaluates proprietary Modified Sticky Delta / IV-slope stress and may report a different loss.
PNR is a RiKi approximation of the single-underlying move where modeled account loss reaches NLV; the PNR/EPR cushion is user-configurable globally and per ticker.
